conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Nathan from billing. What do you need?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Nathan. I want to set up automatic bill payments. I keep forgetting to pay manually and sometimes I'm late.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's a smart idea. We can set it up from your bank account or credit card. Which works better for you?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Bank account is fine. What do I need to provide?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Retention department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Natalie here. I understand you want to cancel your service?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, I'm done. I've had nothing but problems with your company. Outages, slow speeds, terrible customer service. I'm switching to a competitor.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm sorry to hear you've had such a bad experience. Can I escalate this to my supervisor to see if we can make things right?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I appreciate the offer, but I've already decided. Just process the cancellation and send me the final bill. Make sure there are no early termination fees.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Oscar here. What can I help with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Oscar. I'm worried someone accessed my account without permission. I saw a charge for something I didn't buy.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's concerning. Let me look into that. I can help secure your account and reverse any unauthorized charges.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Great. What do I need to do? Should I change my password?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, change it to something strong. I'll also enable two-factor authentication on your account for extra security.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Olivia here. Looking to upgrade your internet?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Actually yes. My current speeds are decent but I'm seeing promotions online for fiber speeds. Is that available in my area?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me check your address. What zip code?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's 60601. How much faster is fiber compared to what I probably have now?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Telecom Haiku.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Walter here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Walter. Do you guys offer business internet packages? I'm starting a small business from home.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We do! We have dedicated business plans with priority support. Let me connect you to our business sales team.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Brenda here. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Brenda. I just bought a new phone and I'm trying to activate my service on it, but it's not working. It says something about registration.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: New phone? That's exciting! I can register it for you. Do you have the IMEI number? It's on a sticker inside the box.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Um, let me look... okay I found the sticker. It's a really long number though. Do I need to read the whole thing?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, read the whole IMEI. Once I register it, your service should activate within a few minutes.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Henry from billing. What's up?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Henry. I'm on a fixed income and I was wondering if you have any programs for low-income customers. I saw something online but I'm not sure.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We do have a program. Let me check if you qualify based on your zip code and income.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: That would be great if I can get a discount. What information do you need from me?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Cynthia here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Cynthia. The Haiku app on my phone keeps crashing when I try to pay my bill. It crashes every time.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That's frustrating. Let me walk you through some troubleshooting steps. First, try uninstalling and reinstalling the app.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, uninstalling... reinstalling... and opening it now... oh! It works! That was quick.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Great! Let me know if it crashes again, but I think you're good to go now.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Ryan here. What can I help with?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Ryan. My daughter just turned 18 and she wants to be added as an authorized user on my account. How do I do that?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Easy process. I need her name and date of birth for verification.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: It's Sarah, born March 15th, 2006. Do I need to have her here to verify?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Welcome. Sales department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Isabel here. Interested in bundling your services?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Maybe. I'm skeptical though. These bundling offers always seem to have hidden fees or they jack up the price after a year.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I understand the skepticism. I promise there are no hidden fees. The price stays the same for two years.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Okay, but what happens after two years? And can I get out early if I want? I don't want to be locked in.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Technical support.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Quentin from support. What's going on?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Quentin. My modem keeps turning off randomly. It's like, every couple of hours it just loses power and won't turn back on until I unplug it.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: That sounds like the power adapter is failing. I can send you a new one, or we can send a technician to troubleshoot.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Just send the power adapter, that's easier. How long will it take? My internet works when the modem's on so I can wait a few days.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Xavier from billing. What do you need?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Xavier. I got disconnected from my service yesterday for non-payment, but I actually paid the bill three days ago. It should have posted.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Let me check the payment status... oh I see the issue. Your payment just posted this morning.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: So can you reconnect me? And do I owe any late fees?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer retention.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yvonne here. I'm so glad you're still with us. Can I interest you in an upgrade?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: An upgrade? I haven't thought about it. What kind of upgrade are we talking about?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: You're on our basic internet plan. For just 10 dollars more, you can get triple the speeds.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Really? That's not too bad. That might actually help with my home office setup. How fast is triple?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Customer service.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Zack here. What's your question?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Zack. Are your modems WiFi 6 compatible? I'm thinking about upgrading my router setup.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, our newer models support WiFi 6. You can request an upgrade if you'd like.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support line.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Darlene here. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Darlene. I'm frustrated. My service went out this morning and it's been down for hours. I have important work calls today.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm really sorry. Let me check what's happening in your area. There might be an outage.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Is there anything you can do? Like compensation for lost service?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Yes, we'll credit your account for the downtime. Service should be restored within the next couple hours.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Sales department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Ethan here from sales. Looking to switch carriers?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah, I've been with my current provider for years but they keep raising prices. I want better value.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: We offer competitive pricing and we have a special this month. New customers get 50 percent off the first three months.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: 50 percent off? That's huge! What's the catch? What's the regular price?

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Account services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Felicia here. How can I assist?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Felicia. I'm worried I'm going to go over my data limit this month. Can you check my usage?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Of course. Let me pull up your account. You're at about 65 percent of your limit with a week left in the month.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Oh good, I should be fine then.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Support services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Gerald from support. What's the issue?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Gerald. I'm switching to Haiku and I want to bring my phone number with me. Can I do that?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Absolutely! We support number portability. I'll need your old carrier and account info to process it.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Great. It's Verizon. How long does it take to switch the number over? I don't want to be without service.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Billing department.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hannah from billing. What do you need?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hi Hannah. I need copies of my last three months of bills. I'm using them for a tax deduction.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I can email those to you, or mail them if you prefer. Which works better?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Email is fine. Just send them to the email address on my account.

conversation.speaker: ivr
conversation.text: Retention services.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Ingrid here. I see you cancelled your service with us. Can I offer you something to come back?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I cancelled because I went with another provider. But honestly, I'm not super happy with them. What could you offer?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: As a returning customer, I can offer you 30 percent off for the first year and free equipment.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Hmm, that's pretty good actually. Let me think about it. Can you send me the details in writing so I can review?
